videos.title: A landlord with 100 properties, and an AI that learns from last year (with voice)

youtube.title: A landlord with 100 properties, and an AI that learns from last year (with voice)
youtube.description: Jordan files the 2025-26 return with the AI assistant and no accountant step. 274 of 275 transactions are sorted from what Jordan confirmed in 2024-25, with no AI model call; only 1 goes to the AI model and only 1 is flagged. The estimate includes the mortgage interest: £571,273 tax on £1,477,310 property profit, with no Class 4 National Insurance. Jordan confirms the year in one click, connects to HMRC and files. Narrated in a British voice, with subtitles.

videos.notes: Recorded on OpsAPI int with the OpsAPI name on screen; client names differ from the Daybook spec. Re-upload under the Daybook channel (decision §1.4) or re-record with the Daybook theme.
